evaluation_coverage: Market baseline is market-derived (not a fitted challenger). M10 feature evidence covered held-out seasons 2022–2025 only.
fallback_behavior: market_only is the production fallback and the approved baseline.
limitations: No ML residual/boosted challenger is registered. Approval is bootstrap governance, not a self-comparison win.
probability_source: Vig-removed two-way moneyline implied probability / market logit from pre-lock CFBD market snapshots when available.
serving_requirements: Serve market probabilities with documented provenance; do not require a fitted model bundle.
timing_limitations: Probabilities require pre-lock market availability; missing moneylines yield no market probability for that game.
